llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define scroll-vs-swipe arbitration with `react-native-gesture-handler` by creating a `Gesture.Native()` scroll gesture and wiring it to row pan via explicit external-gesture relation APIs (for example `simultaneousWithExternalGesture` or `requireExternalGestureToFail`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No Gesture.Native() is created and neither simultaneousWithExternalGesture nor requireExternalGestureToFail is called anywhere; the ScrollView from react-native-gesture-handler is used but no explicit arbitration relation is established between it and the pan gesture.
evidence: App.tsx: panGesture = Gesture.Pan()... – no .simultaneousWithExternalGesture() or .requireExternalGestureToFail() call

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must implement swipe handling with `Gesture.Pan()` and `GestureDetector` using current builder callbacks (`onBegin`/`onUpdate`/`onEnd`) and MUST NOT use legacy `useAnimatedGestureHandler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Gesture.Pan() is used with GestureDetector and the builder callbacks onStart/onUpdate/onEnd; useAnimatedGestureHandler is absent.
evidence: No import or usage of useAnimatedGestureHandler

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Pan `onUpdate` must bound horizontal translation with an explicit clamp path (for example `clamp(...)` or equivalent min/max logic) before assigning the row translate shared value.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: onUpdate explicitly calls clamp(newValue, ROW_OPEN_OFFSET, 0) before assigning to translateX.value.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must configure `Gesture.Pan().activeOffsetX(...)` with explicit numeric thresholds so horizontal movement is required before swipe activation.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: activeOffsetX([-PAN_ACTIVATE_HORIZONTAL_PX, PAN_ACTIVATE_HORIZONTAL_PX]) sets explicit numeric thresholds (±14 px) requiring horizontal movement before activation.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must configure `Gesture.Pan().failOffsetY(...)` with explicit numeric thresholds so vertical movement fails pan and hands interaction back to scroll.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: failOffsetY([-PAN_FAIL_VERTICAL_PX, PAN_FAIL_VERTICAL_PX]) sets explicit numeric thresholds (±10 px) so vertical movement fails the pan gesture.
